## Parental OpControl 0.17.18

- **My OpControl polish.** The **Message my parents** button is now centered in the sidebar and sits a little higher, above the device name and the About link.
- The About header now shows the OpControl IT lockup on the right, beside the Parental OpControl shield, in both themes.
- The server version on About no longer shows `vv0.17.17`; it shows `v0.17.17`. The dashboard was checked and does not have the same double prefix.
- **Built with AI** is now stated clearly. The About credits, the parent dashboard footer, `README.md` and `README.es.md` say that Parental OpControl was designed, directed and tested by Ziur, with design, planning and code review by Claude (Anthropic) and code written by OC, an AI coding agent built on OpenCode and running DeepSeek models. Every change was reviewed and tested by a person before release.
- Both laptops are updated from the normal catalog. No Windows, PIN, family or Luna setting was changed.
